# SpeechToSpike_Encoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that converts speech signals into spike trains using adaptive encoding schemes tailored for spiking neural networks. Enables efficient neuromorphic processing of audio data in in-network systems, reducing latency and power consumption.
